entities.summary: Major-General George Randolph Pearkes was a Canadian politician and soldier. He was a recipient of the Victoria Cross, the highest award for gallantry in the face of the enemy awarded to British and Imperial forces for actions taken during the First World War. He served as the 20th lieutenant governor of British Columbia.
